summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Google login removal feature. All backend APIs working correctly (30/30 tests passed). Frontend UI correctly shows username/password login only, no Google button. User management features (create, update password, PIN, delete) all functional.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/auth/session removed (404)
Backend: Non-local session tokens rejected with 401 'Invalid session'
Backend: POST /api/auth/login creates session_token starting with 'local_'
Backend: GET /api/users excludes password_hash from response
Backend: POST /api/users/manual creates users with optional username/password
Backend: POST /api/users/manual validates username/password requirements
Backend: PATCH /api/users/{id}/password requires username for users without one (400)
Backend: PATCH /api/users/{id}/password rejects duplicate usernames (400)
Backend: PATCH /api/users/{id}/pin sets/clears PIN
Backend: POST /users/verify-pin validates PIN correctly
Backend: DELETE /api/users/{id} prevents deleting self (400)
Backend: DELETE /api/users/{id} prevents deleting last admin (400)
Backend: PATCH /api/users/{id}/role prevents demoting self (400)
Backend: PATCH /api/users/{id}/role prevents demoting last admin (400)
Frontend: Login page has NO Google login button (data-testid google-login-button not found)
Frontend: Login page has username/password inputs (login-username-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button)
Frontend: Login page shows account note 'Akun dibuat oleh admin' (data-testid login-account-note)
Frontend: Username/password login works and redirects to dashboard
Frontend: Users page title 'Manajemen User' displayed
Frontend: 'Tambah User' button present (data-testid add-manual-operator-button)
Frontend: Create user WITHOUT username/password works
Frontend: Access badge shows 'Tanpa Login' for users without username (data-testid access-badge-{user_id})
Frontend: Lock button (data-testid reset-password-{user_id}) opens 'Buat Akun Login' dialog
Frontend: Dialog has input-new-username and input-new-password fields
Frontend: Creating login credentials updates access badge to 'Akun Login'
Frontend: Newly created operator can log in with credentials
Frontend: Operator redirected from admin-only routes (/users)
Frontend: Delete button hidden for current logged-in admin
Frontend: Dashboard loads after admin login
Frontend: Logout works
